gen-dafont-nordic-gf-saira: Ancient and blunt, Nordic stamps its marks far apart. Saira follows in a plain sans, its rounded letters reaching high and every s open, a clear break from the heading's pinched shapes.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sarpanch: Weathered, powerful, a little pressed shut: that's Nordic. Sarpanch takes the other job, an approachable plain sans whose open e and compact ascenders do the quiet work the heading never tries.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans runs tall and modern, its rounded letters open to one side with no thick and thin. Nordic sits above it, ancient and cramped, so the page gets both a carved feel and a clean one.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sono: Sono reads approachable, its sans-serif letters tall and loosely spaced. Nordic's heading, traced at one stylus width and closed up tight, gives that open body something dense to lean against.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-yaldevi: Heavy, ancient, closed up tight: that's Nordic. Yaldevi carries the text in a clean sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens right, so extended reading goes smoothly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-biryani: Nulshock stretches wide and technical. Biryani follows in a clean, approachable sans, its large-eyed e and open small counters keeping paragraphs of text easy going.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-cossette-texte: Technical in the heading, clean in the text: Nulshock spreads out its outlined capitals, and Cossette Texte keeps its wide-eyed e and prominent x-height moving smoothly down many paragraphs.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-duru-sans: Nulshock looks like bent copper pipe, bold and technical, with spacious tracking. And Duru Sans keeps a modern sans-serif line moving, its wide small letters carrying text without any strain.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-fresca: Wide, spaced-out outline capitals mark Nulshock. Fresca takes over below as a modern sans with short ascenders and big bowls, so text keeps flowing without any thin calligraphic snags.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-gafata: Nulshock cuts its heading like laser-etched sheet, spaced wide and bold, with one cutting width throughout. Gafata sits below, tall and contemporary.
